kinds.d: An item that changes the look of a player's character or agent.

kinds.d: A worn add-on item for a character, such as back items, shoes, hats or banners.
An animation or dance a player's character performs on command.
A pet or sidekick that accompanies a player's character.
A ridable creature or vehicle a character rides, often collected account-wide.
